requirements.text: The system shall read initialization data to load heating/cooling unit definitions, thermostat definitions, utilization parameters, trigger values, overtemperature values, and valid temperature ranges.
The system shall initialize by turning off all heating/cooling units and then checking thermostat settings to determine if any units need to be activated.
The system shall validate all incoming temperature data against a predefined valid temperature range.
The system shall monitor temperature status and determine if heating/cooling modes need to be activated based on trigger values.
The system shall manage the status of all heating/cooling units, ensuring the number of concurrently running units does not exceed the maximum allowed utilization parameter.
The system shall generate a unit unavailable event if a heating/cooling request is denied due to capacity limits.
The system shall generate control signals to turn heating/cooling units on or off.
The system shall generate alarm data and audible alerts for invalid temperatures or when temperature limits are exceeded.
The system shall record all events, including alarms and status changes, with a timestamp in a database.
The system shall provide a user interface for the supervisor to change thermostat settings.
The system shall generate operational history and statistical summary reports in ASCII format.
The system shall process thermostat data with no real-time delay.
The system shall provide audible alarm feedback with specific frequency and duration characteristics.
The system shall support heating/cooling units and thermostats across three floors with four quadrants each.
The system shall provide a supervisor interface that avoids excessive information to prevent confusion.
The system shall provide a simulated thermostat for verification and validation of reliability.
The system shall operate on the Microsoft Windows NT operating system.
